_comment: Flow Research · Applied AI Engineering Fellowship, 48 weeks at 20 hours a week.
Distilled from the fellowship guide, the programme overview and the team charter.
start_date is the Monday of week 1 and is the ONE value that has to be right —
every due date, every reminder and the whole timeline derive from it. Change it
here and nothing else needs touching.
path is null until the week 17 decision. Weeks 17-21 carry both tracks; the
resolver returns the chosen one, or both side by side while it is still null.
Reading URLs: arxiv.org/abs/<id> where the id is verified. Where it was not,
the link is an arXiv search for the title instead of a guessed id that 404s.
assignments is where work handed to you during the programme goes —
set books, project briefs, graded assignments. Add one and it files and
nags against its week exactly like planned work. Tell Claude what you were
books run one chapter a week alongside the plan. The chapter number comes
from the week, so nothing has to be ticked off for the count to stay right,
and a book runs out rather than looping. Chapter titles below were written
from memory — correct any that are wrong, they only have to be recognisable.
research_directions: Verifiable agent work evaluation harnesses — automated checks that catch weak agent-submitted work before a human reviewer sees it.
Retrieval-grounded review assistance — surfacing the precedent and evidence a reviewer needs to decide quickly and consistently.
